review:
Sun Princess is a bright cluster-style slot where Sun Ray Frames reshape the grid. A frame can land on a low, high or wild symbol at the start of a spin and, once wins are paid, spreads in straight lines vertically, horizontally or in all four directions, turning everything in its path into the symbol it landed on.

A four-way frame on a wild is the dream outcome, because it can paint a cross of wilds through the middle of the grid. The free spins rounds tilt the odds toward frames and stronger spreads. The ceiling is 10,000x, and the soft pastel art is a nice change from the studio's grittier titles.
